tour.step1desc: Your personal household finance manager. Let me show you around — it only takes a minute.
tour.step2desc: Start here. See your monthly income, expenses, and net balance at a glance. Everything in one clean view.
tour.step3desc: Log expenses in seconds — manually or by scanning a receipt. AI reads it, categorizes it, and logs it for you.
tour.step4desc: Set monthly budgets by category. Watch them update in real time as you spend — know exactly what's left.
tour.step5desc: Create savings goals for anything — a vacation, emergency fund, or down payment. Track progress and celebrate every milestone.
tour.step6desc: Ask anything about your finances. Get personalized advice, spending insights, and help making better money decisions.

landing.announcement: Now in beta — free Pro access for early users
landing.heroTitle: Take control of your household finances.
landing.heroSub: Track every expense, stick to your budget, and reach your financial goals — all in one place.
landing.tabsTitle: Everything your finances need, in one place.
landing.tabsSub: From daily expenses to long-term goals — manage it all from one clean dashboard.
landing.feat1Desc: Log expenses manually or snap a photo of any receipt. AI reads it, categorizes it, and logs it for you — no spreadsheets, no forgetting.
landing.feat2Desc: Set your monthly budget once. Watch it update in real time as you spend. Know exactly how much you have left in every category.
landing.feat3Desc: Create savings goals for anything — vacation, emergency fund, down payment. Track progress visually and celebrate every milestone.
landing.testimonialsTitle: Loved by households who got serious about money.
landing.t1: I finally know where my money goes every month. The budget tracker alone was worth it.
landing.t2: The receipt scanner is a game changer. I used to forget half my expenses — not anymore.
landing.t3: Set up my emergency fund goal in minutes. Watching it grow month by month keeps me going.
landing.t4: I've tried 5 finance apps. This is the first one I actually kept using past week one.
landing.t5: The AI noticed I was overspending on dining. I cut back and saved $200 that month.
landing.t6: Simple enough that my wife and I both use it. Finally on the same page financially.
landing.finalCtaDesc: Free during beta. No credit card required. Start in 2 minutes.
landing.footerTagline: Built for households who care about their money.
